star_schema.rule: Facts contain metrics (amounts, counts). Dimensions contain attributes (names, categories).

naming_convention.columns: snake_case, no abbreviations except standard ones (id, qty, amt)

data_types.ids: STRING — Pancake IDs can be string format

fact_orders.rationale: 99% of queries filter by date + shop. Currency needed for cross-border.

fact_order_items.rationale: Product analysis always scoped by shop and date.

fact_fb_ads.rationale: Ad queries always scoped by account and date.

dim_customers.rationale: Small table (<100K rows), no partitioning needed.

view_patterns.dedup_pattern: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS _row_num, then filter WHERE _row_num = 1
view_patterns.computed_columns: Calculate derived fields (profit, margin, flags) in VIEW definition — no storage cost
view_patterns.status_mapping: Use CASE statement to map raw status INT to status_group STRING
view_patterns.monetary_conversion: All monetary fields: SAFE_CAST(field AS FLOAT64) / 100.0
view_patterns.null_safety: COALESCE(field, default_value) for all computed columns

optimization_rules: Use partition filter in WHERE clause
Pre-aggregate in materialized views for dashboard queries

data_quality_rules: order_id must be NOT NULL and unique (after dedup)
cod ÷ 100 should be > 0 for success orders
partner.cod should be close to cod (reconciliation_gap < threshold)
inserted_at should not be in the future
quantity should be > 0 for non-bonus items
customer_id should exist in dim_customers for most orders
No duplicate order_id after dedup (verify ROW_NUMBER works)
schema_review_checklist: All tables use appropriate PARTITION BY
All tables use appropriate CLUSTER BY
Computed columns are in VIEWs, not physical tables
Status mapping CASE handles all 18 codes + ELSE 'unknown'
Cross-table join keys are consistent type (STRING↔STRING)
Date columns stored as DATE (not STRING) for partition efficiency
Materialized views considered for dashboard aggregations
